# Refactor Your Leadership

> A coaching program for Engineering Managers, new or experienced, who feel stuck, undervalued, or overwhelmed by a role AI is redefining. Led by Fabio Salimbeni.

## About

Refactor Your Leadership helps Engineering Managers build genuine confidence as a leader, communicate in a way that actually lands with each person on their team, and use AI as a real leadership partner rather than just a productivity shortcut. The program is for EMs at any stage: new managers who lack confidence in people-decisions, and experienced managers whose role is being redefined by AI. Both work from the same curriculum, applied to their own real, current workplace situations rather than generic leadership theory.

## Problems the program addresses

- Feeling like an impostor despite technical competence
- Generic leadership advice that doesn't land with individual team members
- No repeatable system for turning around underperformers
- Feeling undervalued despite real impact and a real case for promotion
- Fear of raising promotion conversations directly with a manager
- Conflicting leadership directives and workload/capacity disputes
- Unclear authority, bypassing behaviour, and lack of structured leadership
- General overwhelm from delivery, team wellbeing, and an AI-era role shift nobody trained them for

## Curriculum (10 modules)

1. The AI-Ready Mindset
2. AI as Your Leadership Partner
3. Communicating with AI
4. Trustworthy AI
5. Leading with Curiosity
6. Amplifying Your Leadership
7. Creating Clarity
8. Future-Proof Leadership
9. Building High-Performing Teams
10. From Theory to Practice

## Coach

Fabio Salimbeni became an Engineering Manager in 2019 and hit the same confidence and overwhelm wall many of his clients face. In 2020 he stepped back, did deliberate work on himself, and returned to the role in 2022. He is still an active Engineering Manager and still practising the same work today, and now coaches other Engineering Managers through the same challenges.

## How to get started

There is no sign-up form or checkout. Prospective participants book a free call directly, and the program is discussed and enrolled on that call.
